entries.title: Antique Dome-Top Steamer Trunk
entries.description: A real one-of-a-kind piece, not a reproduction — the kind of trunk that already looks like it belongs at the foot of a Rehoboth guest-room bed.
entries.editorialNote: We picked this one because it's genuinely one-of-a-kind, not a print-on-demand reproduction — the kind of thing that earns its place in a house instead of just filling a corner.

entries.title: Personalized Address Planter Sign
entries.description: A handcrafted wooden porch sign combining custom house numbers with a built-in planter box — the kind of detail that makes a rental feel like somebody's actual home.
entries.editorialNote: Porch details are an easy way to tell a cared-for house from a rented-out one. This is a real maker piece, made to order, not a mass-produced sign.

entries.title: Cape Henlopen Woven Throw Blanket
entries.description: A woven throw featuring Cape Henlopen's coordinates — understated Delaware beach-house style, not a novelty souvenir print.
entries.editorialNote: Most coordinate merchandise is loud. This one reads as a real home textile first, a Delaware reference second.
